summary.text: Patrick Joyce is a member of the Illinois Senate for the 40th Senate District.
His official biography describes him as a local business owner and fourth-generation farmer.

paragraphs.text: Joyce grew up in Reddick, and his biography says he lives in Essex with his wife, Rita.
It says his top goals include making the health care system easier to navigate, ensuring access to clean and affordable drinking water, and reducing class sizes.
The biography says that the loss of his daughter, Katelyn, to leukemia in 2011 inspired his focus on improving the health care system.
It says he has long worked to conserve and protect the Kankakee River and has a background in agribusiness and 25 years operating his own small business and family farm.
